measuredSpectrum.source: ESO VLT/X-shooter wide-slit spectra of PDS 70 from the PENELLOPE programme 105.205R.001 (Manara et al. 2021, A&A 650, A196), ESO Phase 3 products ADP.2021-01-11T12:58:23.979 (UVB arm) and ADP.2021-01-11T12:58:23.935 (VIS arm), observed 2020-12-26

join.reason: X-shooter splits the light at a dichroic: the UVB arm covers 299-556 nm and the VIS arm 534-1020 nm. The join is the middle of their overlap; there the two arms' median fluxes agree to 0.3% below 545 nm and 3.5% above it.

measuredSpectrum.note: The 5 arcsecond wide-slit exposure PENELLOPE takes for absolute flux calibration (ESO FLUXCAL ABSOLUTE), so slit losses do not tilt the colour. PDS 70 is a young star still accreting: its spectrum carries the accretion excess, which is part of its light. No second spectrum cross-checks it: Gaia has no BP/RP spectrum of this star, and the programme's other wide-slit night (2021-03-08) is refused because its two arms differ by 15.8% at the join.
